control-border.$description: The edge of a form control (input, textarea, select, tag input, OTP cell). Light: the hairline, unchanged. Dark: its own value, because the hairline is 1.2:1 there and the edge is the only thing that shows where to type (WCAG 1.4.11).

control-border-hover.$description: A form control's edge under the pointer: one step stronger than --uix-control-border.

text-muted.$description: Muted meta text. Darkened from #737373 so it clears WCAG AA 4.5:1 on the off-white surfaces it sits on (--uix-bg-subtle #F5F5F5, --uix-bg-app #FAFAFA); the old value was 4.34:1 on #F5F5F5.

accent.$description: Runtime: chains through the write-only --uix-brand slot. Must stay var() to keep live brand override.

accent-hover.$description: Primary-button hover. Theme-aware: derived from the live accent so it tracks the brand override (light darkens, dark lightens — see tokens/dark).

accent-text.$description: The brand hue as TEXT on a neutral or --uix-brand-muted surface (a selected filter chip, an active tab label). The raw accent is a fill colour: a bright brand (POSx green, mission-control blue) reads below 3:1 as text on its own tint. Darkened from the live accent so it tracks the brand override; the worst shipped theme is 5.5:1 on brand-muted. Not for text ON a solid accent fill, which is --uix-accent-fg.

brand-muted.$description: Runtime: color-mix of the live accent.

success.$description: Success role, light: the TEXT colour (--uix-success-text aliases it) and the fill of a success button with white --uix-success-fg (5.4:1). Calm kit (2.56): chroma 0.096, was #047857. 4.8:1 on its own tint.

success-text.$description: Success-toned TEXT (pill, alert icon, stat trend, SLA ok). Light aliases --uix-success (#047857, already AA on the pale tint), so a theme's light success override still reaches text; dark sets its own value in the calibrated status-text band (HAR-1562). Paint text with this, not with --uix-success, which is the solid/dot role on dark.

warning.$description: Warning FILL, light (a warning button or banner bar with the dark --uix-warning-fg, 7.4:1). Calm kit (2.56): a softer amber, was #F99C00. Text is --uix-warning-text; a dot is --uix-warning-solid.

warning-text.$description: Warning-toned TEXT, light: 5.4:1 on --uix-surface and 4.8:1 on --uix-warning-bg (calm kit 2.56, was #92400E). Dark mode overrides to track --uix-warning. Used by status-pill --warning.

warning-border.$description: Warning-toned BORDER for an outlined container on a neutral surface (stat tile --warning): 3.2:1 on --uix-surface, so it clears the 3:1 non-text minimum (calm kit 2.56, was #D97706).

info.$description: Info role, light: the TEXT colour on --uix-info-bg (5.1:1) and the fill of an info badge with white --uix-info-fg (5.9:1). Calm kit (2.56): no longer the brand blue #1447E6.

info-text.$description: Info-toned TEXT, legible on --uix-info-bg and the surfaces (5.9:1 on white). Light = --uix-info; dark brightens it. Used by status-pill/alert/node --info.

danger.$description: Danger FILL, light: the destructive button and the solid critical pill (treatment="solid") with white --uix-danger-fg, 5.4:1. Calm kit (2.56): chroma 0.15, was the saturated #E40014 (C 0.24). Text is --uix-danger-text; a dot is --uix-danger-solid.

danger-border.$description: Danger-toned BORDER for an outlined container on a neutral surface (stat tile --danger): 3.9:1 on white, so it clears the 3:1 non-text minimum. Calm kit (2.56), was #E40014.

danger-text.$description: Danger-toned TEXT: 5.4:1 on --uix-surface and 4.7:1 on --uix-danger-bg (calm kit 2.56, was #C20012). --uix-danger stays the FILL role (destructive button, solid critical pill). Dark mode brightens it. Used by pill/alert/stat-trend/field-error/menu/sla/node/audit --danger and StatusDot critical.

amber.$description: SEV-3 / medium-severity tone — the third tier of the severity ramp (danger = SEV-1, warning = SEV-2, amber = SEV-3). A muted ochre, deliberately distinct from the brighter --uix-warning so the three tiers read apart.

amber-text.$description: Amber-toned TEXT, legible on a faint amber tint and on dark surfaces (the SEV-3 ochre is too light as text on pale fills). Dark mode brightens it to track --uix-amber. Used by severity-3 badges.

amber-bg.$description: Amber-toned wash for SEV-3 pill backgrounds. Completes the amber ramp (amber / amber-text / amber-bg) to match the depth of the warning/danger/info ramps.

attention.$description: Time-pressure semantic — 'approaching deadline / SLA at risk'. Distinct from --uix-warning (validation-warning, golden #F99C00) and --uix-danger (error/severity). Covers SLA, renewal-due, EoL/EoS countdown, patch-overdue across modules.

attention-text.$description: Attention-toned TEXT legible on --uix-attention-bg (#FFEDD5). Dark mode brightens to track --uix-attention.

attention-solid.$description: SOLID role for attention fills/dots/pulses (see success-solid).

overdue.$description: Time-pressure semantic, 'breached / past due'. The danger family as a SEPARATE role so products retheme breach independently of validation error. Calm kit (2.56): follows the softened danger values, was #DC2626.

overdue-text.$description: Overdue-toned TEXT legible on --uix-overdue-bg (4.7:1). Calm kit (2.56), was #991B1B. Dark mode brightens.

overdue-solid.$description: SOLID role for overdue fills/dots: 3.9:1 on white (calm kit 2.56, was #EF4444).

sev-4.$description: SEV-4 alias → info tone. Full severity ramp: SEV-1=danger, SEV-2=warning, SEV-3=amber, SEV-4=info, SEV-5=neutral. var() reference — no dark override needed.

sev-5.$description: SEV-5 alias → neutral/muted tone. Lowest priority, minimal visual weight. var() reference — no dark override needed.

success-solid.$description: SOLID status role: the dot/fill/pulse colour, 3.1:1 on white (calm kit 2.56, was #10B981). Distinct from the legible TEXT role (--uix-success). Products override per brand.

warning-solid.$description: SOLID status role (see success-solid): 3.2:1 on white (calm kit 2.56, was #F59E0B, 2.1:1).

info-solid.$description: SOLID status role (see success-solid): 3.9:1 on white (calm kit 2.56, was #2563EB).

danger-solid.$description: SOLID status role: the critical DOT (StatusDot, the dot pill), 3.9:1 on white. Calm kit (2.56): was #EF4444. Not a fill for text; that is --uix-danger.

neutral-solid.$description: NEUTRAL status family (HAR-1562): the default, non-alarming status tone (open, scheduled, draft, in progress). Solid = the dot/fill, 3:1 non-text on white. Dark overrides.

neutral-text.$description: Neutral status TEXT, alias of --uix-text-hushed. var() reference, no dark override needed.

selected-bg.$description: SELECTED usage role (HAR-2816): the chosen option of a segmented control, filter or pill tab. Surface plus the --uix-selected-border hairline, never a hue alone. Alias, no dark override needed.

selected-border.$description: SELECTED usage role (HAR-2816): the hairline that marks the chosen option, >= 3:1 on the track (--uix-bg-subtle) in both themes (usage-roles.test.mjs). Alias of --uix-text-muted.

disabled-text.$description: DISABLED usage role (HAR-2816): the label of an unavailable control. Muted text, no fill and a reason, so disabled differs from enabled without colour alone. Alias of --uix-text-muted.

disabled-border.$description: DISABLED usage role (HAR-2816): the hairline an unavailable control keeps so it still reads as a control. Alias of --uix-border.

chart-1.$description: Categorical palette v2 (calm kit 2.56), light. The first slot is THE series colour (--uix-chart-series) and the brand blue (#0455E6, unchanged from 2.55); 2 teal and 3 violet are the three quiet category hues; 4-8 extend it for report charts. No red slot (red never encodes a series) and no amber slot (amber is reserved for attention). Validated on --uix-surface and --uix-bg-app: L 0.43-0.77, C >= 0.10, adjacent CVD dE >= 8, normal-vision dE >= 15, >= 3:1 (chart-palette.test.mjs).

chart-series.$description: THE series colour of a glance chart (calm kit 2.56): one series in blue, any second one in --uix-chart-comparison grey. Alias of --uix-chart-1, so a theme that re-steps the palette moves it too.

chart-series-soft.$description: The series colour as a faint wash: an area under a glance line, a highlighted bucket. Dark overrides.

chart-grid.$description: Chart gridline: a SOLID 1px hairline, recessive. Dashes are reserved for projections and thresholds (HAR-1552).

chart-reference.$description: Neutral ink for target, budget and baseline reference lines: 7.8:1 on --uix-surface. Not a status colour.

chart-zone-warning.$description: Alpha fill for a warning threshold zone behind the series.

chart-zone-danger.$description: Alpha fill for a danger threshold zone behind the series (the calm danger dot at 8 %).

chart-forecast-band.$description: Alpha fill for a forecast / confidence band; neutral so it works under any series hue.

chart-event.$description: Event-marker line and label ink (deploys, incidents, releases): 4.7:1 on --uix-surface.

chart-partial.$description: Hatch base for a partial (incomplete) period.

chart-comparison.$description: Muted ghost line for the comparison period (last week, last year).

file-img.$description: File kinds (file kit 2.57; office formats split out in 2.59): one hue per kind of attachment, drawn by FileIcon, FileRow and FileDrop. The office kinds take the colour people know from the program: Word blue (doc), Excel green (sheet), PowerPoint orange (slides), PDF red (pdf). Each is tuned so no kind sits within dE 8 of the danger red (red stays for broken) or the brand blue (blue stays for actions), nor within dE 7 of the attention orange. Four kinds equal a calm chart slot in light and alias it, so a file and a chart never fight: img chart-3, mail chart-7, code chart-2, log chart-6. Every kind clears 3:1 on --uix-surface and --uix-bg-app as an icon stroke (file-kinds.test.mjs).

file-img-soft.$description: The kind as a resting tint: the left edge of a FileRow, the start of an upload fill. Dark 15 %.

file-img-strong.$description: The leading end of an upload fill. Dark 26 %.

file-img-edge.$description: A FileRow border: the kind mixed into the line colour. Dark 32 %.

file-img-label.$description: The fill of the type label on a FileIcon corner, under --uix-file-label-fg. Light deepens the kind by 14 % black so white label text clears 4.5:1 on every kind (the plain kinds give white 3.6-4.2:1); dark uses the kind itself.

file-doc.$description: Dokument (Word and other word-processor files, #2B579A): the Word blue, deeper and greyer than the brand blue (dE 12) and far from the e-mail blue.

file-sheet.$description: Tabelle (Excel, #3F8F55). Lighter than Excel's own #217346, which sits on the success green (dE 2).

file-slides.$description: Präsentation (PowerPoint, #C26A1F): a burnt orange, kept off the attention orange (dE 7.6) and the danger reds (dE 7.5 from --uix-danger-solid). PowerPoint's own #C43E1C is the danger red (dE 3).

file-pdf.$description: PDF (#A8103F): a crimson, bluer than the brick danger red (dE 8.7), so a PDF never reads as broken.

file-text.$description: Text (txt, md): the neutral grey of Datei, a kind of its own for its own word.

file-label-fg.$description: Text on a file type label: white in light, ink in dark. 4.5:1 or more on every --uix-file-*-label.

row-selected-bg.$description: Dedicated row-selection background (table tr[aria-selected]). Distinct from --uix-row-pinned-bg (#F4F7FF, very pale blue) and --uix-brand-muted (dynamic accent tint). Enables bulk-selected rows to read apart from pinned rows and inbox unread tints in the same table.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind modal / drawer / side-peek overlays and the avatar edit-overlay — dims the content beneath. Theme-invariant: a black scrim reads on light and dark alike (no dark override).

scrim-strong.$description: Heavier scrim for media-focus surfaces (lightbox), where the backdrop should recede fully behind the image.

print-ink.$description: Text and strong lines on paper. Theme-invariant (no dark override): paper is light whatever theme the screen has. Read only inside @media print, by components that print (HAR-1541).

print-ink-quiet.$description: Secondary text on paper: times, counts, dimmed items. 7.8:1 on print-paper.

print-paper.$description: The page. Used where a printed component must cover what is under it.

print-paper-quiet.$description: A quiet tint for headers when the reader prints background graphics. Nothing may depend on it: it is dropped when they do not.

print-line.$description: Cell and row lines on paper. 3.4:1 on print-paper.

print-danger.$description: The one signal colour on paper (a heavy edge, never a fill, so it survives printing without background graphics). 6.2:1 on print-paper.
